key_value_text.value: Two-flavour nu_mu to nu_tau oscillation: sin^2(2 theta_m) = 1 and delta m^2 = 0.0023 eV^2 (highest probability); no oscillation excluded at about 5 sigma

name: Measurements of atmospheric muon neutrino oscillations, global analysis of the data collected with MACRO detector

significance.quote: The no-oscillation hypothesis is excluded at \(\sim 5\sigma\)

summary.plain: MACRO's final study of neutrinos made in the atmosphere found fewer upward-going muon neutrinos than expected, depending on their energy and path through the Earth. The pattern fits muon neutrinos turning into tau neutrinos.
summary.technical: Final analysis of three atmospheric-neutrino event classes (rates, angular distributions, estimated energies): flux deficit depending on energy and path length; no-oscillation excluded at about 5 sigma, nu_mu to nu_tau fits all data, best two-flavour point sin^2(2 theta_m) = 1, delta m^2 = 0.0023 eV^2, independent of flux normalisation.

title: Measurements of atmospheric muon neutrino oscillations, global analysis of the data collected with MACRO detector
why_it_matters: The final, independent analysis of MACRO atmospheric-neutrino data at Gran Sasso: a flux deficit depending on energy and path length that favours nu_mu to nu_tau oscillation over no oscillation.
